device.description: 24-bit 30 kSPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with PGA, 2 GPIOs and SPI interface (4 mm QFN)

conversion time = 1 / data rate (Table 9, fCLKIN = 7.68 MHz) for every conversion; the first conversion after SYNC/WAKEUP, a mux change or reset settles in t18 (Table 12, longer than 1 / data rate); data rates scale with fCLKIN
DRDY goes high 16 tCLKIN (t17) before each update when data was not read; the update window is not modeled
RDATAC read-data-continuous mode (data shifted out after each DRDY without a command, DIN monitored for SDATAC/RESET): modeled as a single RDATA
STATUS.ORDER (LSB-first output bits) is stored only; output is always MSB first
ACAL auto-calibration and the SELFCAL/SELFOCAL/SELFGCAL/SYSOCAL/SYSGCAL calibrations (OFC/FSC registers not updated; the commands restart a conversion)
SYNC/PWDN: held low stops conversions (modeled as the start pin, active high); held low for 20 DRDY periods powers down; the conversion restart is on the first CLKIN after the rising edge
SCLK reset pattern (Figure 2) and the serial interface reset after SCLK low for 32 DRDY periods
GPIO pins D0-D1 (IO register stored only; DIO does not read the pins) and the D0/CLKOUT clock output (ADCON.CLK)
external clock on CLKIN (not used; fCLKIN 0.1-10 MHz)
t6 delay (50 tCLKIN) required between a read command and the first data SCLK
RREG address wrap past the last register
WAKEUP (00h, FFh) is also the NOP byte: each 00h/FFh byte clocked in (e.g. while reading data) restarts the conversion, which the device does only after SYNC or STANDBY
variants: ADS1257: the 4-input QFN member of the ADS1255/ADS1256 family (same commands and register layout, MUX and IO fields narrowed); own datasheet
